integrity: Analytic identity, invariant-measure generator proof, compact-limit-set argument, and sharp periodic Wirtinger inequality were reviewed; the symbolic checker verifies algebra but not infinite dynamical implications. Relevant literature was materially inspected, with specific inaccessible sources and residual prior-art risks documented. Independent audit has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Assumes locally Lipschitz velocity feedback and compact invariant support; makes no existence, entropy, uniqueness, or stability claim for positive-damping nontrivial states. The imaginary-pair spectral condition does not imply nonlinear Hopf nondegeneracy. Discontinuous impact limits and singular feedback are not included.
title: Sharp global recurrence and period constraints for velocity-feedback jerk equations
